name: Naive Bold Children's Book Cutout
composition: Flat poster or spread with large simple forms, cheerful asymmetry, bold shape language, playful decorative text areas optional.
prompt_core: Create an original Kibookal naive bold children's-book illustration of [SUBJECT]. Use simple flat cutout-like shapes, playful proportions, chunky hand-drawn outlines, bright limited colours, big readable gestures and lots of charm. Keep details minimal and expressive. Add simple flowers, birds or pattern blocks as accents. Make it feel handmade, funny and emotionally clear.
negative: no polished animation look, no photorealism, no complex rendering, no scary mood
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
